source.title: Amendments to the Motions Approved (September 2024)
source.content:
The World Cube Association is governed by a comprehensive set of documents, including the By-Laws, Motions and Policies. The WCA motions define the many functions of the WCA internal operations.

On **August 1st 2024**, the WCA voting staff approved a comprehensive and wide-ranging  [set of changes to the motions](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/396). Below, we have highlighted the most noticeable changes that impact the broader WCA community:
<!-- break -->
1. **Formation of the WCA Integrity Committee**: The WCA Disciplinary Committee and the WCA Ethics Committee have been merged to create the WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) which will oversee the  WCA Code of Ethics and Code of Conduct.  The scope of investigation of this committee has been expanded to also investigate WCA Community members and Regional Organizations, in addition to WCA Staff and Registered Speedcubers. To report any alleged violations or to discuss either of these documents, please contact integrity@worldcubeassociation.org.
2. **Formation of the WCA Appeals Committee**: The WCA’s system of appeals has had a significant uplift with the formation of the WCA Appeal Committee. The  WCA Appeals Committee is made up of  experienced WCA staff members, who hear all appeals received from disputes. In addition, aspects of the appeal process have also been clarified, with grounds for appeals formally outlined and the definition for the conclusion of an appeal case updated.
3. **Removal of the WCA Advisory Council**: The WCA Advisory Council was formed as a body to facilitate bilateral communication between WCA Staff and the broader community. However, it was ultimately realized that this role is best served by WCA Staff rather than by non-staff members of a council. As a result, the WCA Advisory Council has been dissolved, with the duties and selected members integrated into the WCA Communication Team.
4. **Introduction of the WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT)**: This motion change involves the creation of a new WCA Major Championship Team, who will assist in coordinating and improving the quality of  WCA Major Championships. The Championship selection committee will  include WMCT Representatives and reduce the workload of the WCA Board and WCA Senior Delegates & Team/Committee leaders.
5. **Changes to Financial Governance**: The roles of WCA Treasurer and WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader have been split to improve the WCA’s financial governance. The Treasurer will be  responsible for the WCA finances overall, while the WFC Leader will be responsible for oversight of WFC activities and programs including  the Equipment Funding program, Regional Organization Funding program, Travel Funding program and the WCA Dues system.

We believe that these changes will improve the WCA’s operations and governance. If you have any queries about the WCA Motions, please contact the WCA Communication Team (contact@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: WCA 决议修订获通过（2024 年 9 月）
translation.content:
世界魔方协会的运作遵循一套完整的治理文件，包括章程、决议及政策。WCA 决议规定了组织内部运作的各项职能。

**2024 年 8 月 1 日**，有投票权的 WCA 工作人员通过了[一系列范围广泛的决议修订](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/396)。以下列出与广大 WCA 社区成员关系最密切的主要变化：

<!-- break -->

1. **成立 WCA 廉政委员会**：WCA 纪律委员会与 WCA 道德委员会合并为 WCA 廉政委员会（WIC），负责监督《WCA 道德准则》和《WCA 行为准则》的执行。除 WCA 工作人员和注册速拧选手外，委员会的调查范围还扩展到 WCA 社区成员及地区组织。若要举报涉嫌违规行为，或讨论这两份文件，请联系 integrity@worldcubeassociation.org。
2. **成立 WCA 申诉委员会**：WCA 申诉委员会的成立大幅完善了 WCA 的申诉制度。委员会由经验丰富的 WCA 工作人员组成，审理收到的所有争议申诉。同时，申诉流程的一些环节得到明确，包括正式列明申诉依据，以及更新申诉案件结案的定义。
3. **撤销 WCA 顾问委员会**：WCA 顾问委员会原本负责促进 WCA 工作人员与广大社区之间的双向沟通。但最终我们认为，这项职责更适合由 WCA 工作人员承担，而不是由委员会中的非工作人员承担。因此，WCA 顾问委员会已解散，其职责与部分成员并入 WCA 通讯组。
4. **设立 WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）**：本次修订设立了新的 WCA 大型锦标赛组，协助协调赛事工作，提高 WCA 大型锦标赛的办赛质量。锦标赛遴选委员会将纳入 WMCT 代表，以减轻 WCA 董事会、高级代表以及各委员会/团队负责人的工作负担。
5. **调整财务治理结构**：WCA 财务主管与 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人拆分为两个岗位，以完善财务治理。财务主管对 WCA 整体财务负责；WFC 负责人则监督委员会的活动和项目，包括器材资助、地区组织资助、差旅资助及 WCA 会费系统。

我们相信，这些调整将改善 WCA 的运作与治理。如对 WCA 决议有疑问，请联系 WCA 通讯组（contact@worldcubeassociation.org）。
